items.label: Widened Patio Stools
items.value: Elevate your outdoor experience with our widened tall adirondack chairs(W24.5" x D20.5" x H47.6"), designed for enhanced comfort and a splash of vibrant color in your backyard

items.label: HDPE Material
items.value: Enjoy the unique feel of the wood grain texture created by High-density polyethylene material, which offers not only a comfortable surface but also exceptional weather resistance and durability for maximum outdoor enjoyment

items.label: Removable Tray with Umbrella Hole
items.value: Upgrade your outdoor relaxation with these adirondack balcony chairs featuring double detachable trays. Each tray can hold up to 50 lbs, perfect for drinks, snacks, or books. The center of the trays includes a 2-inch umbrella hole for convenient shade.

items.label: 1000-day Trial
items.value: Our after-sales service ensures you receive the utmost care. Should you encounter any issues, please reach out to us anytime – we are dedicated to helping you

items.label: Low maintenance
items.value: Made from eco-friendly, weather-resistant, and easy-to-clean materials, our bar height chairs withstand the elements without fading, and a simple wipe or rinse will keep them looking pristine

items.label: Built-in footrest
items.value: The comfortably designed footrest and armrests enhance your relaxation, allowing you to fully enjoy the beauty of outdoor living with our patio bar stools

items.label: Sturdy and durable
items.value: Built to last, our chairs combine HDPE material with 304 stainless steel screws, supporting up to 360 pounds while maintaining long-lasting durability

items.label: Easy to assemble
items.value: Enjoy hassle-free assembly with 70% pre-installed components; just follow 8 simple steps for a quick setup that one person can easily manage

items.label: Generous Seat Size
items.value: Featuring a spacious seat and a high backrest, our chair boosts comfort levels, accommodating an adult with room for a child to join

items.label: Indoor & Outdoor
items.value: Perfect for both indoor and outdoor use, our wood-grain appearance and variety of color options seamlessly blend into any setting you envision
